The question specifically asks for the memo handlers that broadcast through the hub.

Checking memo_service.go near lines 160 and 513 to identify the relevant functions.

Identifying the memo handlers that broadcast live events.

SSEHub.Broadcast fires directly from CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, and CreateMemoComment. UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects. Reaction handlers on MemoService are excluded.

Also considering whether UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction qualify as memo handlers.

Reaction handlers are included as memo handlers because they broadcast memo refresh events through the hub. Verifying their exact names on MemoService.

The mechanism is Server-Sent Events (SSE).

The hub is implemented in sse_hub.go. Endpoint registration is in sse_handler.go. Memo handlers that broadcast through it are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction.

q20.

**SSE (Server-Sent Events); server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction**

The server pushes live updates over **Server-Sent Events (SSE)**. Clients connect at `GET /api/v1/sse` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`), which sets `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and subscribes clients to the hub.

The hub is **`SSEHub`** in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` — it manages client subscriptions and `Broadcast` sends events to connected browsers.

**Memo-related handlers that broadcast:**

| Handler | Event | File |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `memo.created` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `UpdateMemo` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `DeleteMemo` | `memo.deleted` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `memo.comment.created` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` |
| `UpsertMemoReaction` | `reaction.upserted` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` |
| `DeleteMemoReaction` | `reaction.deleted` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` |

`dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` performs the `memo.updated` broadcast for `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, and `SetMemoRelations`.
